        "contents": "---\nname: Allowed Device List Feature\noverview: Implement optional per-device access control (current location and history) with one-way activation, server synchronization, and unknown visitor management. The feature requires DeviceKey and cannot be disabled once enabled.\ntodos:\n  - id: phase1-data-model\n    content: Extend KnownDevice with ACL fields (hasCurrentLocationAccess, hasHistoryAccess) and update NSCoding for backward compatibility\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase1-settings\n    content: Add allowedDeviceListEnabled flag to SettingsManager with UserDefaults persistence\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase1-ignored-store\n    content: Create IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore singleton for dismissed unknown devices\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase1-manager\n    content: Implement AllowedDeviceListManager with payload building, sync queue, and transactional rollback\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase2-onboarding\n    content: Create iPhone_8_OnboardingAllowedDeviceListView and integrate into onboarding containers\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase2-settings-ui\n    content: Add settings entry for allowed device list feature with status display\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase3-add-dialog\n    content: Add conditional ACL toggles to iPhone_AddDeviceView and wire sync on save\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase3-edit-dialog\n    content: Add conditional ACL toggles to iPhone_EditDeviceView and wire sync on save\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase3-remove-sync\n    content: Wire device removal to sync full list when feature enabled\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase4-unknown-section\n    content: Add unknown visitors section to iPhone_DevicesView with allow/ignore actions\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-localization\n    content: Add all feature strings to Localizable.xcstrings and run export workflow\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-testing\n    content: Write unit tests for payload mapping, backward compatibility, and sync queue\n    status: completed\n  - id: phase5-migration\n    content: \"Verify migration safety: first launch saves ACL defaults, no silent server calls\"",

        "contents": "- Row display: DeviceID, last seen timestamp, optional location snippet\n- Actions:\n  - **Allow**: open &#96;iPhone_AddDeviceView&#96; with prefilled DeviceID + ACL controls (defaults: &#96;current=true&#96;, &#96;history=false&#96;)\n  - **Ignore**: add to &#96;IgnoredVisitorDeviceStore&#96;, remove from section immediately\n- Optional: add \"Ignored Devices\" management screen in settings to reverse ignore actions\n\n### Synchronization Model\n\n**11. Full-list sync on mutations**\nWhen &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled == true&#96;, trigger full-list sync on:\n\n- Device add (via &#96;AllowedDeviceListManager.syncAllowedDeviceListIfEnabled(trigger: .add)&#96;)\n- Device edit/ACL change (trigger: &#96;.edit&#96;)\n- Device remove (trigger: &#96;.remove&#96;)\n- Unknown device allow (trigger: &#96;.unknownAllow&#96;)\n- Initial activation (trigger: &#96;.activation&#96;)\n\n**12. Transactional rollback pattern**\nFor all mutations when feature enabled:\n\n1. Capture snapshot: full &#96;KnownDeviceStore.devices&#96; array (including ACL values, ordering)\n2. Apply local mutation optimistically\n3. Attempt sync with retry policy (exponential backoff)\n4. On final failure: restore snapshot, persist immediately, show error banner with retry action\n5. Log telemetry: trigger, retry count, error class, rollback performed\n\n### Migration Strategy\n\n**13. Backward compatibility**\n\n- &#96;KnownDevice.init(coder:)&#96;: decode ACL keys with defaults &#96;true/true&#96; if absent\n- &#96;SettingsManager.init()&#96;: &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled&#96; defaults to &#96;false&#96; when key missing\n- First launch after update: verify all devices have ACL values in-memory, save archive once (no server call)\n\n**14. Migration safety**\n\n- Existing users remain with feature disabled until explicit activation\n- No silent server ACL writes before opt-in\n- Older archived &#96;knownDevices.plist&#96; files load gracefully with default ACLs\n\n### Internationalization\n\n**15. Localization strings** (&#96;[miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings](miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings)&#96;)\nAdd keys for:\n\n- Feature title, body, CTA labels\n- ACL toggle labels/descriptions (\"Current Location Access\", \"History Access\")\n- Unknown visitor section title, allow/ignore buttons",

with translations for all 10 supported languages (en, de, da, es, fi, fr, it, ja, nl, zh-Hans).\n\n### String Keys and English Source Values\n\n1. **Mutual Navigation**:\n\n   - &#96;\"mutual_navigation_active\"&#96; = \"mutual active\" (comment: \"Indicates that both devices are actively navigating to each other\")\n   - Example usage: &#96;NSLocalizedString(\"mutual_navigation_active\", comment: \"Indicates that both devices are actively navigating to each other\")&#96;\n\n2. **Visitor History**:\n\n   - &#96;\"visitor_history_title\"&#96; = \"Failed to load visitor history\" (comment: \"Error message when visitor history fails to load\")\n   - &#96;\"visitor_history_retry\"&#96; = \"Retry\" (comment: \"Button to retry loading visitor history\")\n\n3. **Device Labels**:\n\n   - &#96;\"unknown_device_label\"&#96;         "contents": "- Device list CRUD behavior remains exactly as today (no ACL payload sync calls).\n\n### 4.2 Add device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User opens Add Device.\n2. UI shows ACL toggles with defaults &#96;current=true&#96;, &#96;history=false&#96;.\n3. On save, add to &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96;, then sync full list.\n4. If final sync failure occurs, rollback to pre-add snapshot and show a localized error explaining restoration.\n\n### 4.3 Edit device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User edits toggles.\n2. Save mutates &#96;KnownDevice&#96;.\n3. Full-list sync is triggered.\n4. If final sync failure occurs, rollback edited values to previous snapshot and notify user.\n\n### 4.4 Remove device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User deletes device.\n2. Remove locally.\n3. Re-send full list without removed device.\n4. If final sync failure occurs, restore removed device + previous ACLs/order and notify user.\n\n---\n\n## 5) Unknown visitors section design (Devices screen)\n\n- Data source:\n  - &#96;VisitorHistoryViewModel.sortedVisitors&#96;\n  - filter unique DeviceIDs not in known devices and not in ignored store.\n- UI:\n  - New section above known devices.\n  - Each row shows DeviceID, last seen timestamp, optional location snippet similar to visitor history row style.\n- Actions:\n  - **Allow**: open add-device sheet with prefilled ID + ACL controls.\n  - **Ignore**: persist to ignored list and remove from this section immediately.\n- Visibility:\n  - Section hidden if resulting list is empty.\n\n---\n\n## 6) Copy/texts and privacy communication\n\nThe feature text should explicitly explain:\n\n- It is optional.\n- It requires DeviceKey to protect ACL updates.\n- Once enabled, the app will actively manage and sync who may access current location and history.\n- It cannot be disabled later, but per-device rights remain editable.\n\nSuggested short onboarding title/body:\n\n- **Title**: “Control which devices can access your location data”\n- **Body**: “Optionally enable access control for linked devices. You can define per device whether current location and location history are shared. This requires a DeviceKey and cannot be turned off later.”\n\nAll strings must be added to &#96;Localizable.xcstrings&#96; and exported to all currently supported languages.",

        "contents": "- **Body**: “Optionally enable access control for linked devices. You can define per device whether current location and location history are shared. This requires a DeviceKey and cannot be turned off later.”\n\nAll strings must be added to &#96;Localizable.xcstrings&#96; and exported to all currently supported languages.\n\n---\n\n## 7) Internationalization plan\n\n1. Add base keys in &#96;miataru/miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings&#96;:\n   - feature title, body, CTA labels, helper text, irreversible-warning text,\n   - toggle labels/descriptions,\n   - unknown-device section title/buttons,\n   - sync error/retry messages.\n2. Run localization export/update workflow used in the project.\n3. Verify no fallback-to-English regressions by spot checking all supported locales.\n\n---\n\n## 8) Error handling and resilience\n\n- Treat API call failures as non-destructive to local edits; provide explicit retry action.\n- Add exponential backoff for background retries when appropriate.\n- Log trigger context (&#96;activation&#96;, &#96;add&#96;, &#96;edit&#96;, &#96;remove&#96;, &#96;unknown_allow&#96;) for debugging.\n- Respect existing DeviceKey auth-block handling patterns.\n\n### 8.1 Transactional rollback on final sync failure\n\nFor any operation that mutates device list and/or ACL values while feature is enabled (add/edit/remove/allow unknown), apply a transactional pattern:\n\n1. Capture a snapshot before mutation:\n   - full &#96;KnownDeviceStore.devices&#96; state (including ACL values, ordering, groups linkages if affected),\n   - related settings state if changed in same flow.\n2. Apply local mutation optimistically.\n3. Attempt full-list sync using &#96;setAllowedDeviceList&#96; with retry policy.\n4. If sync reaches **final failure** (all retries exhausted / non-recoverable error), restore the pre-mutation snapshot fully.\n5. Surface a clear user-facing error explaining:\n   - the server update failed,\n   - the app restored previous device/access configuration,\n   - user can retry later.\n\nThis prevents client/server divergence and ensures users do not remain in a silently inconsistent access-control state.\n\n### 8.2 Rollback UX/telemetry requirements",

Error scenarios**\n\n- API failures: non-destructive to local edits, explicit retry action\n- DeviceKey missing: show prerequisite prompt\n- Network offline: queue pending sync, show unsynced indicator\n- Race conditions: serialized sync queue in &#96;AllowedDeviceListManager&#96;\n- Case sensitivity: normalize DeviceID casing before compare/store/sync\n\n## Testing Requirements\n\n**17. Unit tests**\n\n- Payload mapping: &#96;KnownDevice&#96; → &#96;MiataruAllowedDevice&#96;\n- Backward decode compatibility for old archives\n- Activation preconditions (with/without DeviceKey)\n- Sync queue serialization\n\n**18. Integration tests**\n\n- Activation happy path → flag persisted\n- Add/edit/remove triggers full-list sync when enabled\n- API failure preserves local changes, exposes retry\n\n**19. Manual QA**\n\n- Onboarding branching (no key / key present / enabled)\n- Add/edit toggle defaults and persistence\n- Unknown visitor section visibility and actions\n- Localization spot checks\n- Existing user upgrade path (no forced opt-in)\n- Rollback behavior on sync failures\n\n## Definition of Done\n\nFeature complete when:\n\n1. Users can optionally enable allowed-device-list only after DeviceKey setup\n2. Initial full ACL list seeded to server with correct defaults (&#96;true/true&#96; for existing devices)\n3. Device add/edit/remove fully re-syncs ACL list when enabled\n4. Unknown visitor devices actionable in devices screen (allow/ignore)\n5. Feature cannot be disabled once enabled\n6. Onboarding + settings + localized copy explain privacy/security implications\n7. Automated and manual checks pass\n8. Backward compatibility verified for existing users",

        },
        "contents": "# Allowed Device List Feature — Implementation Plan\n\n## 1) Current state (what already exists)\n\nBased on the current codebase:\n\n- The API layer already supports &#96;setAllowedDeviceList&#96; with per-device access flags (&#96;hasCurrentLocationAccess&#96;, &#96;hasHistoryAccess&#96;) and requires both &#96;DeviceID&#96; and &#96;DeviceKey&#96;. This is exposed in &#96;MiataruAPIClient.setAllowedDeviceList(...)&#96;.\n- The app already supports optional DeviceKey management (&#96;SettingsManager.deviceKey&#96;, onboarding page, settings sheet, auth mismatch handling).\n- Known devices are persisted via &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96; and represented by &#96;KnownDevice&#96; (currently name, id, color, ordering/group info).\n- Visitor history is already loaded and displayed (&#96;VisitorHistoryViewModel&#96; / visitor history views), including an “add unknown visitor as device” flow.\n\nThis makes the new feature mostly an app-domain/state-management and UX integration project, not a protocol design project.\n\n---\n\n## 2) Key product decisions and rationale\n\n### Decision A: How to track whether the allowed-device-list feature is enabled\n\n**Choose:** explicit immutable activation flag + persisted per-device ACL fields.\n\n- Add a dedicated setting flag, e.g. &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled: Bool&#96; in &#96;SettingsManager&#96;.\n- Add ACL fields to each &#96;KnownDevice&#96;:\n  - &#96;hasCurrentLocationAccess: Bool&#96;\n  - &#96;hasHistoryAccess: Bool&#96;\n\n**Why this over “infer from list existence” only?**\n\n- Inference from list/data shape is brittle during migration or partial failures.\n- An explicit flag cleanly models the “one-way activation” requirement (“cannot be disabled”).\n- Per-device ACL fields remain the source of truth for payload generation once enabled.\n\n**Implications:**\n\n- Migration needs defaults for older archived devices.\n- Guardrails are easy: UI and sync logic can branch on &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled&#96;.\n- If enabled but server sync fails, state handling must remain deterministic (see rollout/sync section).\n\n### Decision B: One-way activation behavior\n\n**Choose:** activation is local + server-seeded atomically as one user action, then immutable in UI.\n\n- Activation button triggers:\n  1. Preconditions check (DeviceKey exists).",

        "contents": "This keeps view code thin and avoids scattered API calls.\n\n### 3.3 UI flow integration\n\n1. **Onboarding**\n   - Add a dedicated onboarding page for allowed-device-list.\n   - Reuse the same image asset as DeviceKey onboarding.\n   - CTA logic:\n     - If no DeviceKey: primary action opens DeviceKey setup first.\n     - If DeviceKey exists and feature disabled: show enable/setup action.\n     - If already enabled: show configured/success state.\n2. **Settings**\n   - Add entry to review/manage feature state and explanatory text.\n   - Do not provide “disable” action once enabled.\n3. **Add/Edit device dialogs**\n   - If feature is enabled, show two translated toggles.\n   - If feature is **not** enabled yet, keep add/edit/delete dialogs in their current form and do **not** show ACL toggles.\n   - Edit defaults: existing stored values.\n   - Add defaults (requirement): &#96;current = true&#96;, &#96;history = false&#96; for new devices.\n4. **Devices list unknown section**\n   - Add top section only when unknown devices exist in visitor history and are not ignored.\n   - Actions per row:\n     - **Allow/Add** → open add flow with prefilled DeviceID and ACL defaults, then sync full list.\n     - **Ignore/Disallow** → add ID to ignored store (hidden from this list), no deletion from full visitor history.\n\n---\n\n## 4) End-to-end behavior design\n\n### 4.1 Activation sequence\n\n1. User starts allowed-device-list setup (onboarding/settings).\n2. App checks DeviceKey.\n3. If missing, prompt DeviceKey creation first.\n4. On DeviceKey success, build full ACL payload from known devices with initial defaults (&#96;true/true&#96;).\n5. Call &#96;setAllowedDeviceList&#96;.\n6. On ACK, persist &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled = true&#96;.\n7. From now on, all device list mutations trigger full-list sync.\n\n\n### 4.1a UI gating before feature activation\n\n- Until &#96;allowedDeviceListEnabled == true&#96;, existing add/change/delete device dialogs remain unchanged.\n- No access-rights toggle controls are rendered in these dialogs before activation.\n- Device list CRUD behavior remains exactly as today (no ACL payload sync calls).\n\n### 4.2 Add device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User opens Add Device.",

        "contents": "    status: completed\n  - id: verify-localization\n    content: Verify all user-facing strings are properly internationalized using NSLocalizedString and translated to all 10 languages\n    status: completed\n---\n\n# Implementation Plan: Mutual Navigation and Visitor History\n\n## Overview\n\nThis plan implements two features:\n\n- **A) Mutual Navigation UI**: Detects when both devices are navigating to each other and shows visual indicators\n- **B) Visitor History UI**: Lists devices that have accessed our location, with ability to add unknown devices\n\n## Internationalization Requirements\n\n**CRITICAL**: All user-facing text MUST be internationalized using &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96; with proper English descriptions. No hardcoded strings are allowed.\n\n### Supported Languages\n\nThe app supports **10 languages** and all new strings must be translated to all of them:\n\n- English (en) - source language\n- German (de)\n- Danish (da)\n- Spanish (es)\n- Finnish (fi)\n- French (fr)\n- Italian (it)\n- Japanese (ja)\n- Dutch (nl)\n- Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans)\n\n### Implementation Requirements\n\n1. **All text must use NSLocalizedString**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n   // ✅ CORRECT\n   Text(NSLocalizedString(\"beidseitig_aktiv\", comment: \"Indicates that both devices are actively navigating to each other\"))\n   \n   // ❌ INCORRECT - Hardcoded string\n   Text(\"beidseitig aktiv\")\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Add all strings to Localizable.xcstrings**:\n\n   - File location: &#96;miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings&#96;\n   - Add entries for all 10 supported languages\n   - Use descriptive English comments for translators\n   - Follow existing key naming conventions (lowercase with underscores)\n\n3. **String Key Naming Convention**:\n\n   - Use descriptive, lowercase keys with underscores\n   - Pattern: &#96;context_action_description&#96;\n   - Examples: &#96;mutual_navigation_active&#96;, &#96;visitor_history_title&#96;, &#96;unknown_device_label&#96;\n\n4. **Relative Time Formatting**:\n\n   - Use &#96;DateComponentsFormatter&#96; or similar for relative time",

        "contents": "## Multi‑platform Support\n**For users:**\n- The interface adapts to iPhone, iPad, and Mac, with platform‑specific root views and onboarding flows. iPhone uses a tab bar, iPad presents split views, and Mac currently mirrors the iPhone experience in a resizable window.\n\n- On iPad, you can open device details in separate windows for multitasking.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;MiataruRootView&#96; selects the appropriate root view using size classes and platform checks. Dedicated onboarding containers exist for each platform, and many components in &#96;views/Common&#96; are platform agnostic.\n\n## Localization and Accessibility\n**For users:**\n- Available in English, German, and Japanese, with dynamic type and accessibility labels and hints applied to buttons, tab items, and swipe actions.\n\n- VoiceOver support has been improved across lists and map controls. Alerts and route‑limit messages are localized.\n\n**For developers:**\n- Localizations reside in &#96;en.lproj&#96;, &#96;de.lproj&#96;, and &#96;ja.lproj&#96;. Most text uses &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96; and SwiftUI accessibility modifiers to provide labels, hints, and traits.\n- Units adapt using the system &#96;measurementSystem&#96;. New strings (e.g., daily route‑limit reached) are provided in the string catalog for all supported languages.\n\n---\nThis document serves as a comprehensive reference for both users and developers of the miataru application.",

        "contents": "# Cursor Rules for miataru iOS App\n\n## Project Context\nThis is an open-source iOS application for privacy-friendly location tracking, sharing, and device management. Built with SwiftUI and modern iOS frameworks (iOS 18 and iOS 26).\n\n## Code Style &amp; Standards\n- Use SwiftUI best practices\n- Follow iOS Human Interface Guidelines\n- Maintain privacy-first approach\n- Use English for all code comments and strings\n- Implement proper error handling and battery optimization\n\n## Architecture Guidelines\n- Use ObservableObject and @Published for state management\n- Keep views lightweight and delegate business logic to managers\n- Implement proper MVVM pattern\n- Use UserDefaults for settings persistence\n- Handle location permissions gracefully\n\n## Key Components\n- LocationManager: Handles location tracking and permissions\n- SettingsManager: Manages user preferences\n- Device management and QR code functionality\n- Multi-platform support (iPhone, iPad, Mac)\n\n## Development Workflow\n- Test on multiple device types\n- Consider battery optimization\n- Maintain privacy compliance\n- Follow iOS app store guidelines\n\n## Common Patterns\n- Use @StateObject for view models\n- Implement proper onboarding flow\n- Handle background/foreground transitions\n- Manage device identifiers securely\n\n## Localization Guidelines\n\n### String Localization\n**ALWAYS** use &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96; for all user-facing text strings with proper English descriptions.\n\n#### ✅ Correct Implementation\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nText(NSLocalizedString(\"no_groups_available_create_new\", comment: \"No groups available. Create a new group to get started.\"))\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### ❌ Incorrect Implementation\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nText(\"No groups available. Create a new group to get started.\")\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Localization Key Naming Convention\n- Use descriptive, lowercase keys with underscores\n- Follow the pattern: &#96;context_action_description&#96;\n- Examples:\n  - &#96;group_empty_add_devices_message&#96;\n  - &#96;no_groups_available_create_new&#96;\n  - &#96;edit_device&#96;\n  - &#96;delete_group&#96;\n\n### Comment Guidelines\n- Provide clear, descriptive English text in the comment parameter",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "5. **Accessibility**:\n\n   - &#96;\"visitor_history_accessibility_label\"&#96; = \"Visitor History\" (comment: \"Accessibility label for visitor history button\")\n   - &#96;\"add_device_accessibility_hint\"&#96; = \"Adds this unknown device to your device list\" (comment: \"Accessibility hint for add device button\")\n\n### Implementation Checklist\n\n- [ ] All user-facing strings use &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96; with descriptive English comments\n- [ ] All string keys added to &#96;Localizable.xcstrings&#96;\n- [ ] Translations provided for all 10 supported languages\n- [ ] String keys follow naming convention (lowercase with underscores)\n- [ ] Relative time formatting uses localized format strings\n- [ ] Accessibility labels and hints are localized\n- [ ] No hardcoded strings in Swift code\n\n## File Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nmiataru/\n├── views/\n│   ├── iPhone/\n│   │   ├── iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView.swift (modify - shared, works on both platforms)\n│   │   ├── iPhone_DeviceNavigationView.swift (modify - shared, works on both platforms)\n│   │   └── iPhone_VisitorHistoryView.swift (new - shared, works on both platforms)\n│   └── Common/\n│       ├── MutualNavigationDetector.swift (new)\n│       └── BottomAccessoryModifier.swift (modify)\n├── SettingsManagers/\n│   └── App Settings/\n│       └── RouteInfoState.swift (modify)\nmiataruTests/\n├── MutualNavigationDetectorTests.swift (new)\n└── VisitorHistoryViewModelTests.swift (new)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Note on Platform Support:**\n\n- All views with \"iPhone_\" prefix are actually shared between iPhone and iPad\n- iPad root view (&#96;iPad_RootView&#96;) uses &#96;iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView&#96; directly\n- iPad devices view (&#96;iPad_DevicesView&#96;) navigates to &#96;iPhone_DeviceNavigationView&#96; \n- No separate iPad implementations needed - the views adapt automatically\n\n## Implementation Order\n\n1. **Add all localization strings** to &#96;Localizable.xcstrings&#96; first (en, de, da, es, fi, fr, it, ja, nl, zh-Hans)\n2. Create &#96;MutualNavigationDetector&#96; with polling and hysteresis logic\n3. Integrate mutual detection into &#96;iPhone_DeviceNavigationView&#96;",

          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "**Note on Platform Support:**",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "- All views with \"iPhone_\" prefix are actually shared between iPhone and iPad",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "- iPad root view (&#96;iPad_RootView&#96;) uses &#96;iPhone_MyDeviceQRCodeView&#96; directly",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "- iPad devices view (&#96;iPad_DevicesView&#96;) navigates to &#96;iPhone_DeviceNavigationView&#96; ",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "- No separate iPad implementations needed - the views adapt automatically",
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "## Implementation Order",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Add all localization strings** to &#96;Localizable.xcstrings&#96; first (en, de, da, es, fi, fr, it, ja, nl, zh-Hans)",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Create &#96;MutualNavigationDetector&#96; with polling and hysteresis logic",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Integrate mutual detection into &#96;iPhone_DeviceNavigationView&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 333
          }
        ]

Bool {\n            switch (lhs, rhs) {\n            case (.pending, .pending), (.running, .running), (.ok, .ok), (.warn, .warn):\n                return true\n            case let (.fail(left), .fail(right)):\n                return left == right\n            default:\n                return false\n            }\n        }\n\n        var isTerminal: Bool {\n            switch self {\n            case .pending, .running:\n                return false\n            case .ok, .warn, .fail:\n                return true\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static let maxLogEntries = 500\n    private static let logDateFormatter: DateFormatter = {\n        let formatter = DateFormatter()\n        formatter.dateFormat = \"HH:mm:ss\"\n        return formatter\n    }()\n\n    private let service = DirectionsService()\n\n    static let defaultLanguages: [String] = [\n        \"ar\", \"bg\", \"ca\", \"cs\", \"da\", \"de\", \"el\", \"en\", \"en-GB\", \"en-US\", \"es\", \"es-MX\", \"et\", \"fi\", \"fr\",\n        \"fr-CA\", \"he\", \"hi\", \"hr\", \"hu\", \"id\", \"it\", \"ja\", \"ko\", \"lt\", \"lv\", \"nb\", \"nl\", \"pl\", \"pt\",\n        \"pt-BR\", \"ro\", \"ru\", \"sk\", \"sl\", \"sr\", \"sv\", \"th\", \"tr\", \"uk\", \"vi\", \"zh\", \"zh-Hans\", \"zh-Hant\"\n    ]\n\n    func appendLog(_ message: String) {\n        let timestamp = Self.logDateFormatter.string(from: Date())",

        "contents": "import Foundation\n\n/// Multilingual keyword mappings for navigation maneuver detection.\n/// \n/// ## Why This Mapping Is Necessary\n/// \n/// MapKit's &#96;MKRouteStep.instructions&#96; provides only localized, free-text navigation instructions\n/// (e.g., \"Turn left onto Main Street\" in English, \"Links abbiegen auf Hauptstraße\" in German).\n/// Unlike routing SDKs like Mapbox or HERE, MapKit does NOT expose typed maneuver enums\n/// (e.g., &#96;ManeuverType.left&#96;, &#96;ManeuverModifier.slight&#96;) that would work consistently across locales.\n/// \n/// This creates a fundamental problem: to display appropriate navigation arrows/icons,\n/// we must parse the localized text to determine the maneuver type. However, text parsing\n/// is inherently fragile and locale-dependent.\n/// \n/// ## Our Solution: Hybrid Approach\n/// \n/// 1. **Primary**: Multilingual keyword mapping (this file) - robust across supported locales\n/// 2. **Fallback**: Geometry-based angle detection between route step polylines\n/// 3. **Final fallback**: Default to straight arrow\n/// \n/// This approach prioritizes accuracy from MapKit's localized text while providing\n/// geometric fallbacks when text parsing fails or is ambiguous.\n/// \n/// ## Alternative Approaches (and why we don't use them)\n/// \n/// - **Pure geometry**: Unreliable for complex intersections, roundabouts, highway ramps\n/// - **English-only parsing**: Breaks completely in non-English locales\n/// - **Switch to Mapbox/HERE**: Requires changing the entire routing backend\n/// \n/// ## Contributing\n/// \n/// To add support for your language:\n/// 1. Add tokens to the appropriate arrays below\n/// 2. Include common variants, gendered forms, and synonyms\n/// 3. Keep tokens lowercase; accents are fine\n/// 4. Prefer short substrings that are unlikely to conflict\n/// 5. Test with real MapKit instructions from your locale\n/// \n/// ## Data provenance and coverage\n/// \n/// Many tokens were extracted from a multilingual MapKit walking route sample:\n/// &#96;Sample/NavigationRouteInstructionExtractor/output/2025-10-12-RouteInstructions-1760278219-ToykoRoute.json&#96;.\n/// We covered the following BCP-47 language codes (or their regional variants) listed in",

        "contents": "### Accessibility\n- Provide meaningful labels for interactive elements\n- Use semantic colors and fonts\n- Test with VoiceOver and other accessibility features\n\n### Variable Naming\n- Use camelCase for variables and functions\n- Use descriptive names that explain the purpose\n- Avoid abbreviations unless they are widely understood\n\n## Code Review Checklist\n\n- [ ] Copyright header is present and correctly formatted\n- [ ] All user-facing strings use &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96;\n- [ ] Proper error handling implemented\n- [ ] Memory leaks prevented (timers, publishers cancelled)\n- [ ] Code follows established naming conventions\n- [ ] Appropriate property wrappers used\n- [ ] Performance considerations addressed\n- [ ] Accessibility features implemented\n\n## Memories\n\n### Copyright Header Requirements\n- When new .swift files are created in the project, the cursor rules should automatically insert the standard copyright header. The date field in the header should always be set to the current date.\n\n### Commit Message Language\n- The user prefers commit messages to be written in English.\n\n### String Localization\n- The user prefers that all strings be implemented as NSLocalizedString with correct English descriptions.\n\n## Resources\n\n- [Apple Localization Guide](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode/localization)\n- [SwiftUI Documentation](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swiftui)\n- [iOS Human Interface Guidelines](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/ios)\n\n---\n\n**Remember**: Always prioritize user experience, maintainability, and code quality. When in doubt, follow the established patterns in the existing codebase.",

        "contents": "### Comment Guidelines\n- Provide clear, descriptive English text in the comment parameter\n- Use proper English grammar and punctuation\n- Make the comment self-explanatory for translators\n- Avoid technical jargon in comments\n\n### Adding New Localized Strings\n1. Add the &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96; call in your Swift code\n2. Add the key-value pair to &#96;Localizable.xcstrings&#96;\n3. Provide translations for all supported languages (en, de, ja)\n\n## File Naming Conventions\n\n### Directory Structure\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nmiataru/\n├── views/\n│   ├── iPhone/\n│   ├── iPad/\n│   ├── Mac/\n│   └── Common/\n├── LocationManagers/\n├── SettingsManagers/\n└── Libraries/\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### File Naming\n- iPhone views: &#96;iPhone_ViewName.swift&#96;\n- iPad views: &#96;iPad_ViewName.swift&#96;\n- Mac views: &#96;Mac_ViewName.swift&#96;\n- Common/Shared views: &#96;ViewName.swift&#96;\n- Group related files in descriptive directories\n- Use clear, descriptive names for files\n- Follow the established pattern for platform-specific views\n\n## Copyright Header Requirements\n\n### Mandatory Copyright Header\n**ALWAYS** add the following copyright header to the top of every new Swift file:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * [FileName].swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on [CurrentDate].\n */\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### ✅ Correct Implementation\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * MyNewView.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2025-01-25.\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\n// ... rest of the file content\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### ❌ Incorrect Implementation\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nimport SwiftUI\n// Missing copyright header\n// ... rest of the file content\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Header Guidelines\n- Place the header at the very top of the file, before any imports\n- Replace &#96;[FileName]&#96; with the actual filename (e.g., &#96;MyNewView.swift&#96;)\n- Replace &#96;[CurrentDate]&#96; with the current date in format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2025-01-25)\n- Keep the exact copyright text and format\n- The header must be the first content in every Swift file",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "### Comment Guidelines",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- Provide clear, descriptive English text in the comment parameter",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- Use proper English grammar and punctuation",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- Make the comment self-explanatory for translators",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "- Avoid technical jargon in comments",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "### Adding New Localized Strings",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Add the &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96; call in your Swift code",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Add the key-value pair to &#96;Localizable.xcstrings&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Provide translations for all supported languages (en, de, ja)",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "## File Naming Conventions",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "### Directory Structure",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "miataru/",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "├── views/",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },

        "contents": "# miataru - App Store Description\n\n## Subtitle (30 characters max)\nYour Location, Your Control\n\n---\n\n## Description (4000 characters max) + Prompt\ntake this \"description text\" and translate these in this order: English, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, French, Italian, German, Japanese, Spanish, Simplified-Chinese \nOutput in this language order and make each language individually copyable markdown.Each copyable markdown portion has a small note of the language before the markdown and no markdown headline itself. It should be real markdown.\n\nDescription Text:\n\nTake control of your location sharing with miataru - the privacy-focused location sharing app that puts you in charge.\n\nmiataru is a powerful location tracking and sharing app designed for people who value privacy and control. Share your location with family, friends, or trusted devices through your own Miataru server, keeping your data secure and under your control.\n\nPrivacy First:\nYour location data belongs to you. miataru connects to Miataru servers that you choose, ensuring your location information never goes through third-party services you don't trust. You control who sees your location and when.\n\nSmart Location Tracking:\n• Background and foreground location sharing\n• Battery-optimized tracking that respects your device's power\n• High-accuracy updates when you need them, efficient monitoring when you don't\n\nMulti-Device Management:\n• Track multiple devices from a single app\n• Organize devices into custom groups for easy management\n• See battery levels, altitude, speed, and distance for each device\n\nBeautiful Maps &amp; Navigation:\n• Interactive maps with accuracy indicators\n• Real-time device positions with visual feedback\n• Off-screen arrows point to devices outside your current view\n• Built-in navigation with route planning and progress tracking\n\nEasy Sharing:\n• Generate QR codes to share your device instantly\n• Scan QR codes to add new devices quickly\n• Share via email, messages, or any app\n\nDesigned for iOS:",

        "contents": "# Development Guide - miataru iOS App\n\n## Quick Start for Developers\n\n### Prerequisites\n- Xcode 16.0+ (iOS 18.0+ deployment target)\n- iOS 18.0+ device or simulator\n- Swift 5+\n- macOS 14.0+ (for development)\n\n### Setup\n1. Clone the repository\n2. Open &#96;miataru/miataru.xcodeproj&#96; in Xcode\n3. Select your development team in project settings\n4. Build and run on target device/simulator\n\n## Project Structure Deep Dive\n\n### Core Architecture\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nmiataru/\n├── miataruApp.swift          # App entry, global state, onboarding &amp; deep links\n├── views/                    # UI components\n│   ├── Common/               # Shared UI elements\n│   ├── iPhone/               # Root, devices, groups, settings, QR\n│   ├── iPad/                 # Root, devices, groups, settings\n│   └── Mac/                  # Onboarding previews (no Mac target)\n├── LocationManagers/         # Location handling (fg/bg, significant-change)\n├── SettingsManagers/         # User preferences &amp; data stores\n│   ├── App Settings/         # SettingsManager, Settings.bundle\n│   ├── Devices/              # KnownDevice, KnownDeviceStore\n│   └── Groups/               # DeviceGroup, DeviceGroupStore\n└── Assets/                   # Resources &amp; localization (xcstrings, icons)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Common Components Overview\n\n- Shared UI (&#96;views/Common/&#96;):\n  - &#96;ErrorOverlay&#96; (transient errors), &#96;ViewModifiers&#96; (&#96;adaptiveToolbarBackground&#96;, &#96;adaptiveNavigationBackground&#96;)\n  - &#96;DeviceRowView&#96;, &#96;GroupRowView&#96;, &#96;DeviceNameLabel&#96; (label caching), &#96;DeviceBatterySymbol&#96;\n  - Map helpers (&#96;views/Common/Map/&#96;): &#96;MiataruMapMarker&#96;, &#96;PulsingAccuracyCircle&#96;, &#96;MapScaleBar&#96; + &#96;MapScaleBarViewModel&#96;, &#96;MapCompass&#96;, &#96;OffScreenDeviceArrow&#96;, &#96;OffscreenDeviceEdgeHelper&#96;, &#96;RouteGhostCalculator&#96;, &#96;RouteStyle&#96;, &#96;Shimmer&#96;\n- Stores &amp; caches:\n  - &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96;, &#96;DeviceGroupStore&#96; (secure archiving to Application Support)",

        "contents": "- To support multiple locales, the kit:\n  - First tries a multilingual keyword map (English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Japanese; easy to extend)\n  - Then falls back to geometry‑based angle detection between step polylines\n  - Finally defaults to straight when neither approach is decisive\n\nWhy this exists: Without a typed maneuver in MapKit, mapping across all locales requires heuristics. This hybrid approach is practical but community help improves coverage and accuracy.\n\n### How you can help\n\n- Add keywords for your language in &#96;NavigationInstruction.symbolFromLocalizedInstruction(_:)&#96;.\n  - Include variants, gendered/plural forms, and common synonyms.\n  - Keep tokens lowercase; accents are fine. Prefer short substrings that are unlikely to conflict.\n- Add unit tests in &#96;NavigationOverlayKitTests&#96; with real instructions captured from MapKit for your locale.\n- If you see a mis‑classified turn, open an issue and include:\n  - Locale and full instruction text\n  - Expected maneuver (e.g., sharpLeft)\n  - Optional: previous/current step coordinates for geometry fallback validation\n\nIf you need guaranteed correctness across many languages, consider using a routing SDK that exposes typed maneuvers (e.g., Mapbox or HERE) and feed its steps into &#96;NavigationOverlayViewModel&#96;.\n\n## Screenshot\n![Simulator Screenshot - iPhone 17 Pro Max - 2025-10-11 at 16.12.14.png](https://github.com/bietiekay/NavigationOverlayKit/blob/master/Simulator%20Screenshot%20-%20iPhone%2017%20Pro%20Max%20-%202025-10-11%20at%2016.12.14.png)\n\n## License\n\nNavigationOverlayKit is provided with BSD 2-Clause \"Simplified\" License. See LICENSE file.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- To support multiple locales, the kit:",

          },
          {
            "text": "  - First tries a multilingual keyword map (English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Japanese; easy to extend)",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Then falls back to geometry‑based angle detection between step polylines",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Finally defaults to straight when neither approach is decisive",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "text": "Why this exists: Without a typed maneuver in MapKit, mapping across all locales requires heuristics. This hybrid approach is practical but community help improves coverage and accuracy.",
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "text": "### How you can help",
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "- Add keywords for your language in &#96;NavigationInstruction.symbolFromLocalizedInstruction(_:)&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Include variants, gendered/plural forms, and common synonyms.",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Keep tokens lowercase; accents are fine. Prefer short substrings that are unlikely to conflict.",
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "- Add unit tests in &#96;NavigationOverlayKitTests&#96; with real instructions captured from MapKit for your locale.",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "- If you see a mis‑classified turn, open an issue and include:",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Locale and full instruction text",

          },
          {
            "text": "  - Expected maneuver (e.g., sharpLeft)",

          },
          {
            "text": "  - Optional: previous/current step coordinates for geometry fallback validation",

          },
          {
            "text": "If you need guaranteed correctness across many languages, consider using a routing SDK that exposes typed maneuvers (e.g., Mapbox or HERE) and feed its steps into &#96;NavigationOverlayViewModel&#96;.",

        "contents": "- Data &amp; Caching:\n  - &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96;, &#96;DeviceGroupStore&#96; (secure archiving under Application Support)\n  - &#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore&#96; (latest device locations + reverse geocoded placemarks)\n  - &#96;RouteCacheStore&#96; (cached routes keyed by device/transport; distance threshold validation)\n- Utilities:\n  - &#96;thisDeviceIDManager&#96; (device ID generation + legacy migration)\n  - &#96;Haptic&#96; (feedback utilities)\n\n## 🔑 Key Features\n\n### Location Management\n- **Privacy-First**: User controls all location sharing\n- **Battery Optimized**: High-accuracy foreground; significant-change background\n- **Permission Handling**: Staged requests (WhenInUse → Always when opted-in)\n- **Background Support**: Significant-change updates\n\n### Device Management\n- **Multi-Device**: Track multiple devices\n- **Group Support**: Organize devices into groups\n- **QR Code Sharing**: Share own device, scan to add others\n- **Deep Link**: &#96;miataru://&lt;DEVICE_ID&gt;&#96; adds devices via sheet\n\n### User Experience\n- **Onboarding Flow**: Guided setup (iPhone/iPad-optimized)\n- **Settings Control**: Comprehensive preferences via SettingsManager\n- **Error Handling**: Transient overlays\n- **Localization**: German, English, and Japanese\n\n## 📱 Platform-Specific Considerations\n\n### iPhone\n- Touch-optimized interface\n- Location permission workflows\n- Deep-link and QR onboarding\n- Battery optimization features\n\n### iPad\n- Larger screen layouts\n- Split view support\n- Enhanced device management\n- Optimized for productivity\n\n### Mac\n- Not currently targeted (Mac directory hosts onboarding previews only)\n\n## 🛠️ Development Guidelines\n\n### Code Organization\n- **Views**: Minimal UI logic, delegate to managers\n- **Managers**: Handle business logic and data\n- **Models**: Use SwiftUI data binding\n- **Assets**: Organized by platform and feature\n\n### State Management\n- Use ObservableObject for view models\n- Implement proper MVVM pattern\n- Handle app lifecycle changes\n- Manage user preferences reactively\n\n### Testing Strategy\n- Unit tests for business logic\n- UI tests for critical flows",

        "contents": "            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {\n                // Device name\n                HStack(spacing: 4) {\n                    if let device = knownDevice {\n                        Text(device.DeviceName)\n                            .font(.headline)\n                            .foregroundColor(colorScheme == .light ? .black : .white)\n                    } else {\n                        HStack(spacing: 4) {\n                            Text(NSLocalizedString(\"unknown_device_label\", comment: \"Label for unknown/unrecognized device\"))\n                                .font(.headline)\n                                .foregroundColor(colorScheme == .light ? .black : .white)\n                            Text(shortenedDeviceID(visitor.DeviceID))\n                                .font(.headline)\n                                .foregroundColor(.secondary)\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \n                    if isIgnored {\n                        Image(systemName: \"eye.slash.fill\")\n                            .font(.caption)\n                            .foregroundColor(.secondary)\n                            .accessibilityLabel(Text(\"visitor_history_ignored_indicator\"))\n                    }\n                }\n                \n                // Subtitle: Last seen with timezone (like DeviceRowView)\n                TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 1)) { context in\n                    let subtitle = subtitleText(now: context.date)\n                    Text(subtitle)\n                        .font(.caption2)\n                        .foregroundColor(colorScheme == .light ? Color.black.opacity(0.6) : Color.white.opacity(0.7))\n                        .lineLimit(1)\n                        .truncationMode(.tail)\n                }\n                \n                // Distance (separate line)\n                let distance = distanceText()\n                Text(distance)\n                    .font(.caption2)",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/Allowed Device List Feature-concept.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 128
          },

        "contents": "- Device list CRUD behavior remains exactly as today (no ACL payload sync calls).\n\n### 4.2 Add device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User opens Add Device.\n2. UI shows ACL toggles with defaults &#96;current=true&#96;, &#96;history=false&#96;.\n3. On save, add to &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96;, then sync full list.\n4. If final sync failure occurs, rollback to pre-add snapshot and show a localized error explaining restoration.\n\n### 4.3 Edit device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User edits toggles.\n2. Save mutates &#96;KnownDevice&#96;.\n3. Full-list sync is triggered.\n4. If final sync failure occurs, rollback edited values to previous snapshot and notify user.\n\n### 4.4 Remove device sequence (when enabled)\n\n1. User deletes device.\n2. Remove locally.\n3. Re-send full list without removed device.\n4. If final sync failure occurs, restore removed device + previous ACLs/order and notify user.\n\n---\n\n## 5) Unknown visitors section design (Devices screen)\n\n- Data source:\n  - &#96;VisitorHistoryViewModel.sortedVisitors&#96;\n  - filter unique DeviceIDs not in known devices and not in ignored store.\n- UI:\n  - New section above known devices.\n  - Each row shows DeviceID, last seen timestamp, optional location snippet similar to visitor history row style.\n- Actions:\n  - **Allow**: open add-device sheet with prefilled ID + ACL controls.\n  - **Ignore**: persist to ignored list and remove from this section immediately.\n- Visibility:\n  - Section hidden if resulting list is empty.\n\n---\n\n## 6) Copy/texts and privacy communication\n\nThe feature text should explicitly explain:\n\n- It is optional.\n- It requires DeviceKey to protect ACL updates.\n- Once enabled, the app will actively manage and sync who may access current location and history.\n- It cannot be disabled later, but per-device rights remain editable.\n\nSuggested short onboarding title/body:\n\n- **Title**: “Control which devices can access your location data”\n- **Body**: “Optionally enable access control for linked devices. You can define per device whether current location and location history are shared. This requires a DeviceKey and cannot be turned off later.”\n\nAll strings must be added to &#96;Localizable.xcstrings&#96; and exported to all currently supported languages.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

          {
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "- It is optional.",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "- It requires DeviceKey to protect ACL updates.",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "- Once enabled, the app will actively manage and sync who may access current location and history.",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "- It cannot be disabled later, but per-device rights remain editable.",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "Suggested short onboarding title/body:",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Title**: “Control which devices can access your location data”",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Body**: “Optionally enable access control for linked devices. You can define per device whether current location and location history are shared. This requires a DeviceKey and cannot be turned off later.”",
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "All strings must be added to &#96;Localizable.xcstrings&#96; and exported to all currently supported languages.",
            "lineNumber": 184
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.2727428674697876
    },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/mutual_navigation_and_visitor_history_0bbbadc5.plan.md",

        "contents": "    status: completed\n  - id: verify-localization\n    content: Verify all user-facing strings are properly internationalized using NSLocalizedString and translated to all 10 languages\n    status: completed\n---\n\n# Implementation Plan: Mutual Navigation and Visitor History\n\n## Overview\n\nThis plan implements two features:\n\n- **A) Mutual Navigation UI**: Detects when both devices are navigating to each other and shows visual indicators\n- **B) Visitor History UI**: Lists devices that have accessed our location, with ability to add unknown devices\n\n## Internationalization Requirements\n\n**CRITICAL**: All user-facing text MUST be internationalized using &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96; with proper English descriptions. No hardcoded strings are allowed.\n\n### Supported Languages\n\nThe app supports **10 languages** and all new strings must be translated to all of them:\n\n- English (en) - source language\n- German (de)\n- Danish (da)\n- Spanish (es)\n- Finnish (fi)\n- French (fr)\n- Italian (it)\n- Japanese (ja)\n- Dutch (nl)\n- Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans)\n\n### Implementation Requirements\n\n1. **All text must use NSLocalizedString**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n   // ✅ CORRECT\n   Text(NSLocalizedString(\"beidseitig_aktiv\", comment: \"Indicates that both devices are actively navigating to each other\"))\n   \n   // ❌ INCORRECT - Hardcoded string\n   Text(\"beidseitig aktiv\")\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Add all strings to Localizable.xcstrings**:\n\n   - File location: &#96;miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings&#96;\n   - Add entries for all 10 supported languages\n   - Use descriptive English comments for translators\n   - Follow existing key naming conventions (lowercase with underscores)\n\n3. **String Key Naming Convention**:\n\n   - Use descriptive, lowercase keys with underscores\n   - Pattern: &#96;context_action_description&#96;\n   - Examples: &#96;mutual_navigation_active&#96;, &#96;visitor_history_title&#96;, &#96;unknown_device_label&#96;\n\n4. **Relative Time Formatting**:\n\n   - Use &#96;DateComponentsFormatter&#96; or similar for relative time",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "    status: completed",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "  - id: verify-localization",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "    content: Verify all user-facing strings are properly internationalized using NSLocalizedString and translated to all 10 languages",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },

            "lineNumber": 34

          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "# Implementation Plan: Mutual Navigation and Visitor History",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "This plan implements two features:",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- **A) Mutual Navigation UI**: Detects when both devices are navigating to each other and shows visual indicators",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "- **B) Visitor History UI**: Lists devices that have accessed our location, with ability to add unknown devices",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "## Internationalization Requirements",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "**CRITICAL**: All user-facing text MUST be internationalized using &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96; with proper English descriptions. No hardcoded strings are allowed.",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "### Supported Languages",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "The app supports **10 languages** and all new strings must be translated to all of them:",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "- English (en) - source language",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "- German (de)",

          },
          {
            "text": "- Danish (da)",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },

            "text": "- Spanish (es)",

          },

          },

          {

          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **All text must use NSLocalizedString**:",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;swift",

            "text": "   // ✅ CORRECT",

        "contents": "    private func distanceText() -&gt; String {\n        let distanceLabel = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_distance\", comment: \"Label for the distance to the device in the device list row\")\n        \n        guard let visitorCached = cache.getLocation(for: visitor.DeviceID),\n              let myCached = cache.getLocation(for: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID) else {\n            let unknown = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_unknown\", comment: \"Default value for unknown distance\")\n            return \"\\(distanceLabel): \\(unknown)\"\n        }\n        \n        let visitorLoc = CLLocation(latitude: visitorCached.latitude, longitude: visitorCached.longitude)\n        let myLoc = CLLocation(latitude: myCached.latitude, longitude: myCached.longitude)\n        let distance = visitorLoc.distance(from: myLoc) // in meters\n        \n        let usesMetric: Bool\n        if #available(iOS 16.0, *) {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.measurementSystem == .metric\n        } else {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.usesMetricSystem\n        }\n        \n        let formattedDistance: String\n        if usesMetric {\n            let meterUnit = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_meter_unit\", comment: \"Unit for meters in device row distance display\")\n            let kilometerUnit = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_kilometer_unit\", comment: \"Unit for kilometers in device row distance display\")\n            if distance &lt; 1000 {\n                formattedDistance = String(format: \"%.0f %@\", distance, meterUnit)\n            } else {\n                formattedDistance = String(format: \"%d %@\", Int(round(distance / 1000)), kilometerUnit)\n            }\n        } else {\n            let feetUnit = NSLocalizedString(\"device_row_feet_unit\", comment: \"Unit for feet in device row distance display (imperial)\")",

        "contents": "    func loadVisitorHistory(showLoading: Bool = true) async {\n        guard let url = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL) else {\n            errorMessage = NSLocalizedString(\"visitor_history_error\", comment: \"Error message when visitor history fails to load\")\n            return\n        }\n        \n        if showLoading {\n            isLoading = true\n        }\n        errorMessage = nil\n        \n        do {\n            let ourDeviceId = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n            // Request with nil amount to get all available from server\n            APIRequestCounter.shared.record(.getVisitorHistory)\n            let response = try await MiataruAPIClient.getVisitorHistoryWithConfig(\n                serverURL: url,\n                forDeviceID: ourDeviceId,\n                deviceKey: settings.deviceKey,\n                amount: nil\n            )\n            self.visitors = response.MiataruVisitors\n            self.isLoading = false\n        } catch {\n            if let authMessage = DeviceKeyAuthHandler.handle(error: error) {\n                self.errorMessage = authMessage\n            } else {\n                self.errorMessage = NSLocalizedString(\"visitor_history_error\", comment: \"Error message when visitor history fails to load\")\n            }\n            self.isLoading = false\n            debugLog(\"[VisitorHistoryViewModel] Failed to load visitor history: \\(error)\")\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func shouldRefresh(isVisible: Bool) async -&gt; Bool {\n        guard settings.autoRefreshDeviceList,\n              isVisible else {\n            return false\n        }\n\n        let isActive = UIApplication.shared.applicationState == .active\n        guard isActive else {\n            return false\n        }\n\n        let interval = Double(settings.outsideMapUpdateInterval)\n        let now = Date()\n\n        if let last = lastRefresh, now.timeIntervalSince(last) &lt; interval {\n            return false\n        }\n\n        return true\n    }\n}\n\nstruct VisitorHistoryStateView&lt;Content: View&gt;: View {\n    @ObservedObject var viewModel: VisitorHistoryViewModel",

        "contents": "2. &#96;VisitorHistoryViewModelTests&#96;:\n\n   - Test known vs unknown device resolution\n   - Test that after adding unknown device, same entry resolves to known device name\n   - Mock &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96; updates\n\n**Test Files:**\n\n- &#96;miataruTests/MutualNavigationDetectorTests.swift&#96;\n- &#96;miataruTests/VisitorHistoryViewModelTests.swift&#96;\n\n## Localization - Required Strings\n\n**MANDATORY**: All strings below must be added to &#96;miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings&#96; with translations for all 10 supported languages (en, de, da, es, fi, fr, it, ja, nl, zh-Hans).\n\n### String Keys and English Source Values\n\n1. **Mutual Navigation**:\n\n   - &#96;\"mutual_navigation_active\"&#96;         "contents": "    private static func deviceKeyAuthMessage(for error: Error) -&gt; String {\n        guard let apiError = error as? MiataruAPIClient.APIError else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"device_key_auth_required_message\", comment: \"Message when device key authentication is required\")\n        }\n        switch apiError {\n        case .serverError(_, let message):\n            let lowercased = message.lowercased()\n            if lowercased.contains(\"does not match\") || lowercased.contains(\"doesn't match\") {\n                return NSLocalizedString(\"device_key_auth_mismatch_message\", comment: \"Message when stored DeviceKey does not match server\")\n            }\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"device_key_auth_required_message\", comment: \"Message when device key authentication is required\")\n        default:\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"device_key_auth_required_message\", comment: \"Message when device key authentication is required\")\n        }\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "    status: completed\n  - id: verify-localization\n    content: Verify all user-facing strings are properly internationalized using NSLocalizedString and translated to all 10 languages\n    status: completed\n---\n\n# Implementation Plan: Mutual Navigation and Visitor History\n\n## Overview\n\nThis plan implements two features:\n\n- **A) Mutual Navigation UI**: Detects when both devices are navigating to each other and shows visual indicators\n- **B) Visitor History UI**: Lists devices that have accessed our location, with ability to add unknown devices\n\n## Internationalization Requirements\n\n**CRITICAL**: All user-facing text MUST be internationalized using &#96;NSLocalizedString&#96; with proper English descriptions. No hardcoded strings are allowed.\n\n### Supported Languages\n\nThe app supports **10 languages** and all new strings must be translated to all of them:\n\n- English (en) - source language\n- German (de)\n- Danish (da)\n- Spanish (es)\n- Finnish (fi)\n- French (fr)\n- Italian (it)\n- Japanese (ja)\n- Dutch (nl)\n- Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans)\n\n### Implementation Requirements\n\n1. **All text must use NSLocalizedString**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;swift\n   // ✅ CORRECT\n   Text(NSLocalizedString(\"beidseitig_aktiv\", comment: \"Indicates that both devices are actively navigating to each other\"))\n   \n   // ❌ INCORRECT - Hardcoded string\n   Text(\"beidseitig aktiv\")\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Add all strings to Localizable.xcstrings**:\n\n   - File location: &#96;miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings&#96;\n   - Add entries for all 10 supported languages\n   - Use descriptive English comments for translators\n   - Follow existing key naming conventions (lowercase with underscores)\n\n3. **String Key Naming Convention**:\n\n   - Use descriptive, lowercase keys with underscores\n   - Pattern: &#96;context_action_description&#96;\n   - Examples: &#96;mutual_navigation_active&#96;, &#96;visitor_history_title&#96;, &#96;unknown_device_label&#96;\n\n4. **Relative Time Formatting**:\n\n   - Use &#96;DateComponentsFormatter&#96; or similar for relative time",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "    private func mapAPIError(_ error: MiataruAPIClient.APIError) -&gt; String {\n        switch error {\n        case .invalidURL:\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"server_url_invalid\", comment: \"The server URL is invalid.\")\n        case .invalidResponse(_):\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"server_response_invalid\", comment: \"The server response was invalid.\")\n        case .encodingError(let err):\n            return \"\\(NSLocalizedString(\"encoding_error\", comment: \"Error encoding the request.\")) \\(err.localizedDescription)\"\n        case .decodingError(let err):\n            return \"\\(NSLocalizedString(\"decoding_error\", comment: \"Error processing the server response.\")) \\(err.localizedDescription)\"\n        case .requestFailed(let err):\n            return \"\\(NSLocalizedString(\"network_error\", comment: \"Network error. Please check your internet connection.\")) \\(err.localizedDescription)\"\n        case .serverError(_, let message):\n            return String(format: NSLocalizedString(\"server_error\", comment: \"Server error: %@\"), message)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func applyQuickRange(duration: TimeInterval, bounds: ClosedRange&lt;Double&gt;) {\n        let upper = bounds.upperBound\n        let lower = max(bounds.lowerBound, upper - duration)\n        let newRange = lower...upper\n        selectedRange = newRange\n        displayRange = newRange\n        scrubTimestamp = upper\n        hasUserScrubbed = false\n        scheduleRegionUpdate(animated: true)\n    }\n\n    private func isQuickRangeSelected(duration: TimeInterval, bounds: ClosedRange&lt;Double&gt;) -&gt; Bool {\n        guard let selectedRange else { return false }\n        let upper = bounds.upperBound\n        let lower = max(bounds.lowerBound, upper - duration)\n        let epsilon: Double = 1.0\n        return abs(selectedRange.lowerBound - lower) &lt;= epsilon &amp;&amp; abs(selectedRange.upperBound - upper) &lt;= epsilon\n    }\n\n    private func clampScrubToRange() {\n        guard let bounds = selectedRange else { return }",

        "contents": "public struct MiataruGetVisitorHistoryResponse: Codable {\n    public let MiataruServerConfig: MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig\n    public let MiataruVisitors: [MiataruVisitor]\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case MiataruServerConfig\n        case MiataruVisitors\n    }\n\n    public init(MiataruServerConfig: MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig, MiataruVisitors: [MiataruVisitor]) {\n        self.MiataruServerConfig = MiataruServerConfig\n        self.MiataruVisitors = MiataruVisitors\n    }\n\n    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n\n        // Decode server config\n        MiataruServerConfig = try container.decode(MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig.self, forKey: .MiataruServerConfig)\n\n        // Decode visitors array with graceful handling of malformed entries\n        guard var visitorsContainer = try? container.nestedUnkeyedContainer(forKey: .MiataruVisitors) else {\n            MiataruVisitors = []\n            return\n        }\n\n        var parsedVisitors: [MiataruVisitor] = []\n        var index = 0\n\n        while !visitorsContainer.isAtEnd {\n            do {\n                let entry = try visitorsContainer.decode(MiataruVisitor.self)\n                parsedVisitors.append(entry)\n            } catch {\n                debugLog(\"[MiataruAPIClient] Skipping malformed visitor entry at index \\(index): \\(error)\")\n                _ = try? visitorsContainer.decode(SkipDecodable.self)\n            }\n            index += 1\n        }\n\n        self.MiataruVisitors = parsedVisitors\n    }\n}\n\nprivate struct SkipDecodable: Decodable {\n    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        ",

        "contents": "public struct MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig: Codable {\n    public let MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory: String\n    public let AvailableVisitorHistory: String\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory\n        case AvailableVisitorHistory\n    }\n\n    public init(MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory: String, AvailableVisitorHistory: String) {\n        self.MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory = MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory\n        self.AvailableVisitorHistory = AvailableVisitorHistory\n    }\n    \n    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        \n        // MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory can come as String or number\n        if let maxString = try? container.decode(String.self, forKey: .MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory) {\n            MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory = maxString\n        } else if let maxInt = try? container.decode(Int.self, forKey: .MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory) {\n            MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory = String(maxInt)\n        } else if let maxDouble = try? container.decode(Double.self, forKey: .MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory) {\n            MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory = String(Int(maxDouble))\n        } else {\n            MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory = \"0\"\n        }\n        \n        // AvailableVisitorHistory can come as String or number\n        if let availString = try? container.decode(String.self, forKey: .AvailableVisitorHistory) {\n            AvailableVisitorHistory = availString\n        } else if let availInt = try? container.decode(Int.self, forKey: .AvailableVisitorHistory) {\n            AvailableVisitorHistory = String(availInt)\n        } else if let availDouble = try? container.decode(Double.self, forKey: .AvailableVisitorHistory) {\n            AvailableVisitorHistory = String(Int(availDouble))\n        } else {\n            AvailableVisitorHistory = \"0\"\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// The structure of the response for a GetVisitorHistory request.\npublic struct MiataruGetVisitorHistoryResponse: Codable {\n    public let MiataruServerConfig: MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "public struct MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig: Codable {",
